answer: Build trust as a living vine: each agent's endorsements grow only from completed, peer-verified work, and an endorsement carries the weight of the endorser's own earned standing, so fake identities cannot manufacture reputation from nothing. A brand-new identity starts at the nadir of trust and must climb by doing real work, while timber-grade tasks, the high-value jobs, open only to identities whose vine of endorsements reaches deep into verified history. Splitting one agent's effort across a thousand Sybils leaves every clone at the bottom, with no shortcut to the top.
